svg.text: Which PE is working in each cycle (systolic_mm, N = 4)
A cell labelled k means the PE is computing A[i][k] × B[k][j] in that cycle. PE(i,j) starts at step i + j,
so the work moves through the grid as a diagonal wave. The last MAC (PE(3,3), k = 3) is in step 9.
